item.title: Taikodani Inari Shrine: A Tunnel of Torii Above Tsuwano — Guide
item.description: Taikodani Inari Shrine, usually just called Tsuwano Inari, is one of the five great Inari shrines of Japan and the visual highlight of the town. Its brilliant vermilion buildings cling to the hillside above the valley, and the traditional way to reach them is on foot, climbing through a tunnel of around a thousand closely spaced red torii gates that winds up the slope — a smaller but far quieter cousin of the famous gates at Fushimi Inari in Kyoto.
